name: Octree-based Level of Detail and Culling
definition: A technique to handle large point clouds by building an octree at load time. Each node caches the average of points beneath it. It performs frustum culling and view-dependent sampling to reduce the number of points rendered.
summary: Octree-based Level of Detail and Culling reduces rendering load by using the CPU to aggregate point data into cached averages and perform frustum culling before uploading to the GPU.
